definition: A pack that reaches this style by descent and that the style's own record refuses, saying why — as a one-storey house refuses a rule for graduating storeys. A decline stops a wrong pack; it does not supply a right one.
basis: Our wording of the style record's declined packs field and the inheritance layer's limit on it. schema/style-node.schema.json, declined_packs description: "Packs that reach this node BY DESCENT and do not belong on it."; schema/style-node.schema.json, declined_packs reason description: "Why this pack does not belong on this node, in a sentence."; schema/style-node.schema.json, declined_packs reason description: "refuses `storey-graduation` because it has one storey and a rule for graduating a stack has no stack to graduate."; docs/inheritance.md: "It stops a wrong pack; it does not supply a right one".
